name: 加厚防泼溅一次性塑料桌布款
description: 铺桌防泼溅防污，餐后一卷即弃，素色多色适配长短桌

styleLock.direction: clean everyday-tableware ecommerce, calm studio proofing plus believable daylight rooms
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless porcelain white #FFFFFF for packshots and the variant board, pale dove-grey studio panel #E7E7E1 for information screens, moss-tinted wash #E9EFDD for benefit and closing screens, deep charcoal interior #35322E for the disposal screen, real daylight rooms and lawn for lifestyle frames
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral high-key studio light, broad front-left key with a fill card, soft contact shadows, controlled sheen on thin plastic, single skimming pass only on texture screens; daylight frames use one clear sun direction matched to prop shadows
styleLock.surfaceSystem: cool pale stone counter #E4E4DF, matte porcelain studio board #F4F4F1, pale ash table top #D8CDBE under the drape in lifestyle frames
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with generous letter spacing, one headline line plus short chips only, all real wording left as blank plates in the template
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in moss green #7E8F45, geometric, unfilled, no emoji, no badge artwork with readable text
styleLock.presentationRules: the draped sheet keeps believable folds, straight corner falls and contact weight; the folded bundle stays squared with visible layered edges and a plain unprinted band; hero angle and product scale stay stable across screens; nothing floats without a contact shadow
noDrift: no printed patterns, wordmarks or numerals added to the sheet
no invented certifications, lab data or measurement values
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean everyday-tableware ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of porcelain white #FFFFFF, pale dove-grey #E7E7E1, moss green accent #7E8F45 and charcoal text #2C2E31; neutral high-key studio lighting with a broad front-left key, fill card, soft contact shadows and controlled sheen on thin plastic; seamless porcelain white field for packshots, pale dove-grey panels for information screens, moss-tinted wash #E9EFDD for benefit and closing screens, believable daylight rooms for lifestyle frames; modern geometric sans-serif with generous letter spacing; thin single-weight line icon style in moss green only; draped sheet keeps believable folds, straight corner falls and contact weight while the folded bundle stays squared with visible layered edges; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no printed patterns or wordmarks on the sheet.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用整叠束装加背后铺好的桌型交代品类与分量感。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, bundle centred low in frame with the draped table fully inside behind it
shots.lighting: bright neutral high-key studio light, broad front-left key with fill card, soft contact shadow under the bundle
shots.props: none except the softly blurred draped table behind the bundle
shots.whitespace: clean white margin on both sides, none inside the subject area
shots.promptTemplate: Packshot of {product}: a tidy squared bundle of folded sheets bound by a plain unprinted accent band, with a softly draped table standing behind it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera straight-on at eye level so the whole bundle and the draped table behind it sit fully inside the frame, bundle centred low, table kept slightly soft. Bright neutral high-key studio lighting, broad front-left key with a fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow grounding the bundle. Seamless porcelain white background #FFFFFF. The bundle together with the table silhouette occupies 60-70% of the frame. Clean white margin on both sides and no extra whitespace inside the subject. Tack-sharp commercial e-commerce rendering. Negative: no wordmark or logo on the band, no numerals or unit labels anywhere, no colour swatch thumbnails in this frame, no hard plastic glare, no floating edges, no cut-off corners, no watermark, no text.

shots.background: moss-tinted wash #E9EFDD with a reserved blank headline plate top left

shots.lighting: low-key warm room light from the right, heavier on the problem side, soft floor shadow under the shoes
shots.background: kitchen corridor in deep charcoal #35322E with out-of-focus cabinets
shots.props: one bin silhouette and a chair edge, never covering the bundled sheet
shots.whitespace: darker reading zone held on the left side, none inside the figure
shots.promptTemplate: Pain-point screen: a used sheet gathered and knotted into a bundled sack carried away from a dinner table, figure cropped from the neck down in a plain home apron so no identity is readable. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera straight-on at eye level with a candid documentary feel, the bundle held low at the side, a table leg and a chair edge anchoring the room. Low-key warm room light from the right, dimmer and heavier toward the problem side, soft floor shadow under the shoes. Background kitchen corridor in deep charcoal #35322E with blurred cabinet fronts. Props: one bin silhouette and one chair edge, never covering the bundle. The figure carrying the bundle occupies 40-50% of the frame. Whitespace kept as a darker reading zone on the left, no extra air inside the figure. shots.intent: 用压纹微距证明料面质感与防泼溅机制，替代口头主张。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a very low angle skimming across the sheet surface, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: single skimming key from the right at low incidence, controlled sheen, no blown highlights
shots.background: the same material continuing into soft focus over cool pale stone #E4E4DF
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture itself is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the surface of {product}, tight zoom on the embossed micro-dot relief where a fold catches the light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera from a very low angle skimming across the sheet so the embossing reads as a fine regular relief, shallow depth of field with the near ridge tack sharp and the far side falling away. Single skimming key from the right at a low incidence, controlled sheen rather than blown speculars. Background is the same material continuing into soft focus over cool pale stone #E4E4DF. The textured detail fills 55-60% of the frame. Minimal whitespace because the texture is the subject. Negative: no blurry subject, no textile weave or paper-fibre look, no torn or melted edges, no printed pattern or logo, no water marks or dust, no props, no text, no watermark.

shots.background: pale dove-grey studio panel #E7E7E1 on both panels with a thin moss divider #7E8F45
shots.props: two blank label chips under the panels
shots.whitespace: structured air around the two blank chips only
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce two-panel comparison of {product} with matched side-by-side panels under identical framing and identical lighting: left panel shows a flat bead of liquid resting on the sheet face, right panel shows the same sheet lifted at one corner revealing a clean dry underside. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Both panels photographed straight-on from a high 45-degree angle looking down, same working distance and same crop on each side. Even neutral overhead softbox with one light skimming pass from the left, identical soft shadows on both panels. Background pale dove-grey studio panel #E7E7E1 on both sides, one thin moss divider line #7E8F45, blank label chips beneath each panel with wording supplied later as {callout_1} and {callout_2}. Each panel's sheet occupies 50-60% of its own half. Whitespace around the blank chips only, no dense body copy. Negative: no competitor packaging or marks, no check or cross icons implying a real brand, no before-and-after faces, no readable verdict text, no fabricated test data, no mismatched crops, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：图一为素色整叠束装（腰封带强调色块）配背后铺好的长桌，右下角另有一片小桌多色缩略方阵；图二为压纹料面大特写，下方两格插图分别呈现液滴停在布面与提起布角见干爽底面，顶部有英文标题与副标题；图三为绿底信息图，含矩形桌示意、三种垂落高度插画与一张参数对照表（含星标选中行）；图四为颈部以下裁切的人物把用过台布打结装袋提走，左侧三行英文主张；图五为庭院日光长桌派对场景；图六为烛光节庆长桌场景；图七为窗边日常早餐桌场景。品类判定依据：主体是铺在餐桌上的素色即弃薄膜台布，无电无加热、贴身铺设于餐厨台面，故取家居日用下水具餐具，leaf 为加厚一次性塑料桌布；未取家纺布艺，因源图强调防泼溅即弃的餐桌耗材属性而非织物台布。与源类目路径无冲突。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与系列名、腰封上的件数数字与英文字样、源图内全部英文标题与主张原句、信息图中的尺寸数字与座位数及星标行、缩略方阵里的具体色名与格纹印花、人物面容与身份、平台角标与评价标识；所有数值与主张改为留空参数行、空表格单元、空印章框与占位符。
